articles.title: This 3,400-Year-Old Folding Chair Is the Only One of Its Kind in Europe
articles.summary: A folding chair from 1400 B.C., found in a Danish chief's grave, is the only fully preserved Bronze Age chair in Europe. It shows ancient people traded ideas across continents.

articles.title: Coco Gauff Says Rival Eala Faces 'More Pressure' as a Pioneer
articles.summary: Coco Gauff says Alexandra Eala has more pressure because she's the first Filipino tennis star. Eala won a big title and is ranked 18th, making history for her country.

articles.title: Space Nukes: A 60-Year Ban Nobody Can Enforce
articles.summary: Nuclear weapons have been banned in space since 1967, but there's no way to check. A new satellite sensor might finally solve that, but it's tricky.
